title: Enhancing Reprogramming Towards Induced Human Expanded Pluripotency
author: Haoqing HU
materials: Cells are washed once with PBS.

steps.title: Prepare Feeder Cells
steps.instruction: Prepare SNL76/7 feeder cells for reprogramming.

substeps.instruction: Culture SNL76/7 feeders in M10 medium on 0.2% gelatin-coated plates until they reach 90-100% confluence.
Incubate cells with M10 medium containing 10 µg/mL mitomycin-C for 4 hours (use immediately after dissolving as it is light-sensitive and degrades at room temperature).
Wash cells with PBS.
Dissociate into single cells with TrypLE for 3 min at 37 °C and neutralize with M10 medium.
Centrifuge at 300 xg for 3 min and discard the supernatant.
Cryopreserve cell pellets in freezing medium (90% FBS and 10% DMSO) and store at -80 °C.
Seed HEK293T cells at 2.5×10^6 cells per 60 mm dish and culture overnight in 293T medium.
On the day of transfection, mix 4 µg of plasmids (polycistronic reprogramming cassettes or M2rtTA), 2.4 µg psPAX2, 1.6 µg pMD2.G, and 16 µg PEI in DMEM.
Incubate the mixture for 15 min at room temperature, then add to the cells.
Change culture medium to fresh 293T medium containing 1 mM Sodium Butyrate (NaB) 10–14 hours post-transfection.
Collect lentivirus-containing supernatant at 48, 72, and 96 hours post-transfection; keep at 4 °C and pool together. Add fresh 293T medium without NaB back after collection.
Remove cell debris by passing the supernatant through 0.45 µm filters once and centrifuging at 2000 xg for 10 min at room temperature.
Aliquot and store lentivirus at -80 °C (stable up to 1 year).

steps.title: Transduce Human Fibroblasts
steps.instruction: Transduce human adult or neonatal dermal fibroblasts (HDFs) with reprogramming lentiviruses.

substeps.instruction: Dissociate HDFs with TrypLE at 37 °C for 3 min and neutralize with HDF medium.
Centrifuge at 300 xg for 3 min and seed 2-2.5 x 10^4 cells per 0.2%-gelatin coated well of a 12-well plate in HDF medium.

Prepare transduction mix for 1 well: mix lentivirus-containing supernatant (reprogramming cassette:M2rtTA = 2:1 ratio) with polybrene to a final concentration of 8 μg/mL, bringing total volume to 1.0 mL with M15 medium.

Guideline for virus volume: add 150–300 µL of unconcentrated reprogramming-cassette lentiviral supernatant plus half that volume of M2rtTA lentivirus (adjust based on titer, efficiency, and toxicity).
Aspirate HDF medium completely and immediately add 1.0 mL transduction mix to each well; incubate overnight.

steps.title: Recover and Expand Transduced Cells
steps.instruction: Recover cells and initiate the reprogramming process using Doxycycline (DOX).

substeps.instruction: Change medium to fresh VLD medium containing 0.5 µg/mL DOX for recovery. If no significant cell death occurs over 2–6 days, this step can be omitted and 1 µg/mL DOX used directly.
Change medium to fresh VLD medium containing 1 µg/mL DOX.
Change medium with fresh VLD medium (1 µg/mL DOX) every day.
Dissociate transduced fibroblasts with TrypLE at 37 °C for 3 min and neutralize with M10 medium.
Centrifuge and re-plate cell pellets onto feeder cells (feeder-based) or Geltrex (feeder-free) at 1.5 x 10^4 live cells per well of a 12-well plate in VLD medium (1 µg/mL DOX).
Change medium with fresh VLD medium (1 µg/mL DOX) every day until compact, dome-shaped cell clusters emerge.

steps.title: Induce Expanded Pluripotency
steps.instruction: Transition cells to hEPSCM to finalize iEPSC colony formation.

substeps.instruction: Change medium to hEPSCM supplemented with 1 µg/mL DOX.
Change medium every day to hEPSCM supplemented with 1 µg/mL DOX for 3-5 days until dome-shaped iEPSC colonies reach desired size and shape.
Culture cells with DOX-free hEPSCM for 2 days before colony counting (total hEPSCM duration must be at least 5 days).

steps.title: Identify and Pick Colonies
steps.instruction: Identify CD75-positive colonies and isolate them.

substeps.instruction: Fix cultures with 4% PFA on the last day; perform ICC and stain with anti-CD75 antibody to count dome-shaped CD75-positive colonies.
Manually pick dome-shaped colonies at the end stage of reprogramming.

steps.title: Expand and Purify iEPSC Clones
steps.instruction: Expand picked colonies based on the culture condition.

substeps.instruction: For feeder-based colonies: Pipette into small pieces and seed onto fresh feeder layers in hEPSCM with 10 µM Y-27632 for the first 24 hours. Change medium daily with hEPSCM (without Y-27632) until desired size is reached. Passage as single cells onto new feeder layers. Repeat colony picking for two additional rounds. After the third round, passage with TrypLE for expansion or cryopreservation.

For feeder-free colonies: Pipette into small pieces and seed onto Geltrex or Matrigel-coated plates in feeder-free hEPSCM with 10 µM Y-27632 for the first 24 hours. Change medium daily with feeder-free hEPSCM and 2.5 μM Y-27632 until desired size is reached. Perform colony picking only once, then transfer to Geltrex- or Matrigel-coated plates for expansion or cryopreservation.

steps.title: Characterize iEPSCs
steps.instruction: Perform immunocytochemistry to validate pluripotency markers.

substeps.instruction: Fix cells with 4% PFA for 15 minutes at room temperature.
Permeabilize in PBS with 0.2% Triton X-100 for 10 minutes at room temperature.
Block with 5% BSA in PBS for 2 hours at room temperature.
Incubate with primary antibody (NANOG, OCT4, SSEA4, TRA-1-60) diluted in 1% BSA in PBS overnight at 4 °C.
Wash three times for 5 minutes with PBS.
Incubate with secondary antibodies diluted in 1% BSA in PBS for 1 hour at room temperature.
Counterstain nuclei with NucBlue Fixed Cell Stain.

steps.title: Derive Embryoid Bodies (EBs)
steps.instruction: Differentiate iEPSCs into EBs to test lineage potential.

substeps.instruction: Dissociate human iEPSCs into single-cell suspensions using TrypLE and seed at 5000 cells per well of an ultra-low 96-well plate in DFK medium.
On day 2, add 100 µL of fresh DFK medium per well.
If using feeder layers, remove feeders by incubating in 0.2% gelatin-coated wells at 37 °C for at least 45 min; harvest loosely attached cells for EB formation.
On day 4, transfer approximately 6 EBs per well to a Geltrex-coated 24-well plate in DFK medium.
Change medium every other day for 12-14 days.
Fix cultures with 4% PFA and stain for lineage markers TUJ1, α-SMA, and FOXA2.
Dissociate iEPSC clones into a single-cell suspension with TrypLE.
If using feeder layers, remove feeders by incubating in 0.2% gelatin-coated wells at 37 °C for at least 45 min; harvest loosely attached cells.
Seed cells on Matrigel or Geltrex-coated plates in TSCM.
Change medium with fresh TSCM every other day for approximately 1 week until TSC-like morphology emerges.
Fix cultures with 4% PFA and stain for KRT7, GATA2, GATA3, and NANOG.
